# Input event-trace fixtures (`veskra-input`)

> **SYNTHETIC DATA — NOT HARDWARE CAPTURES.**
> Every file here was generated by deterministic Rust code. None of it was recorded from a real
> tablet, stylus or digitizer. These traces test the arbiter's *logic* (state machine, ordering,
> confirmed/predicted separation, palm/cancel policy, gesture math). They say **nothing** about
> real device behaviour: pressure response, report rates, hover range, tilt accuracy, palm
> cancellation timing or button reporting on any device.
>
> **SPK-02 (hardware stylus event truth) is BLOCKED**: this environment has no physical
> Android tablet or pen. Real traces must be captured on reference devices and added as
> separate, clearly named files (for example `hw_<device>_<scenario>.jsonl`) with a
> `hardware/devices.yaml` entry. Do not replace or relabel these synthetic files as hardware
> evidence. STY-001/002/004/006 still need their HW evidence column. STY-003/005 are HW-only in
> VERIFICATION_MATRIX.md; these traces cover only their logic.

## Format

JSON Lines. Each line is one `veskra_input::RawPointerEvent` (serde) in **view** pixels:

```json
{"action":"Move","pointer_id":0,"tool":"Stylus","x":312.23438,"y":412.125,"t_ns":1066666672,"pressure":0.1875,"tilt":0.25,"orientation":-2.3125}
```

`action` ∈ `Down, Move, Up, Cancel, PointerDown, PointerUp, HoverEnter, HoverMove, HoverExit`.
`tool` ∈ `Stylus, StylusEraser, Finger, Mouse, Unknown`. Fields left out mean `None`, `false`
or `0`: an absent axis is **not reported** (NaN in the packed JNI layout, CONTRACTS §8). Unknown
fields are rejected. Parse with `veskra_input::trace::parse_jsonl`. Every event also
round-trips through the packed JNI layout (`pack_events` / `unpack_events`).

## Regenerating

The generators are in `crates/veskra-input/tests/support/mod.rs`. They use only IEEE basic
arithmetic and `sqrt` (no `sin`/`cos`/`pow`), so the output is the same on every platform. The
`fixtures_match_deterministic_generator` test fails if a file differs from its generator.
After you change a generator on purpose:

```sh
VESKRA_REGEN_INPUT_FIXTURES=1 cargo test -p veskra-input --test fixtures
```

## Files

| File | Events | Scenario | Expected (default `InputConfig`) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stylus_confirmed.jsonl` | 1523 (750 historical, 500 predicted) | Hover, then stylus stroke A with tilt/orientation (150 frames of 3 historical + 1 current at 240 Hz, plus 2 predicted per frame; its UP repeats the last position). More hover, then eraser stroke B with no tilt/orientation (100 frames; its UP is at a new position). | 2 commits. Confirmed samples = 601 + 402 = 1003, monotonic `t`, pressure in [0,1], `HISTORICAL` on historical samples. 1 duplicate UP dropped. Predictions only in `StrokePrediction`. Stroke B is `eraser: true`, and its tilt and azimuth are `None` (STY-001/002/007). |
| `stylus_cancel_and_palm.jsonl` | 177 | (1) A palm-sized finger (major 180 px) before any stylus. (2) A finger stroke whose UP has `FLAG_CANCELED`. (3) A finger stroke whose contact grows to palm size. (4) Stylus stroke A. (5) Stylus stroke B ended by `ACTION_CANCEL`. (6) Stylus stroke C with a resting palm (major 200 px), lifted with `FLAG_CANCELED`. (7) A normal finger after the stylus. | Strokes: finger→Cancel, finger→Cancel, A→Commit, B→Cancel, C→Commit (41 stylus-only samples). 3 palms rejected. The palm never navigates. Only (7) pans the view (STY-004, palm logic). |
| `pen_pressure_curve.jsonl` | 151 | (1) A pressure ramp from 0.00 to 1.00 in steps of 0.01. (2) Out-of-range pressures −0.25 and 1.25. (3) A stylus that does not report pressure. (4) A mouse stroke. | (1) The curve is applied, the output is monotone and `PRESSURE_REPORTED` is set. (2) Two clamps are counted. (3) and (4) use `FALLBACK_PRESSURE` (0.5) without `PRESSURE_REPORTED`. |
| `two_finger_gesture.jsonl` | 205 | (A) A pinch that zooms 2× and rotates about 30° while the centroid drifts. (B) A two-finger tap. (C) A three-finger tap. (D) A slow two-finger hold of 400 ms. (E) A two-finger pan by (+150, −80). | The anchor stays within 1e-6 doc px after every `ViewChanged`. No stroke actions occur during a gesture. With `finger_draws`, each sequence's first finger starts a 1-sample stroke that the second finger **cancels**. One `TwoFingerTap` and one `ThreeFingerTap`; D is not a tap. E keeps zoom and rotation bit-identical (STY-005 logic). |
